audience: manufacturers that run production, stock and purchasing in MRPeasy

useCases.title: Spot stock at or below its minimum
useCases.text: List the critical on-hand stock report and the on-hand inventory per stock item. Open one stock item to see its variations.

useCases.title: Follow customer orders and sales invoices
useCases.text: List customer orders with filters on customer and dates, and open one to see its lines. Check the sales invoices for the same customer.

useCases.title: Track purchase orders from vendors
useCases.text: List purchase orders with filters on vendor and dates, and open one to see its lines. Read the vendor record for the contact details.

useCases.title: Review manufacturing orders and their bills of materials
useCases.text: List manufacturing orders by product, customer order or dates. Open one to see its operations and parts, and read the bill of materials for the product.

useCases.title: Trace shipments to their orders
useCases.text: List shipments by linked order, tracking number or dates. Open one shipment to see its details.
